name: FR-3060
description: "This auto player was born in pursuit of basic performance.The FR series uses an independent 16-pole synchronous motor as the power source for autoplay in order to solve the unnatural motion in which the autoplay operation speed changes by changing the rotational speed of the record, so that all auto operation is performed at a constant speed.The Oatley turn detector uses a unique electromagnetic mechanism that combines a ferrite magnet and a reed switch so that no lateral pressure is applied to the needle tip and smooth operation is possible.Fully automatic operation is realized without changing manual operation, and manual operation is possible even during automatic operation such as stopping and returning the arm by hand or starting from the desired position during operation.The turntable shaft surface is processed by centerless polishing processing. name: FR-4060
description: "An automatic record player equipped with an electronic automatic mechanism.It inherits the basic performance and functions of conventional manual players and is automated.The effect of arm side pressure, which is a problem in auto player, is solved by a unique auto mechanism using magnet, reed switch and exclusive 16-pole timing motor. All auto operations can be performed at constant speed.If you pull the cue lever at Start/Cut, the instrument automatically starts playing and returns to the arm armrest at the end of playing. You can also cut the instrument in the middle with one touch operation of the lever. If you want to enjoy playing repeatedly, you can play continuously by pulling the lever down to REPEAT.Since the auto mechanism has no mechanical contact during recording performance, manual setting is not necessary even during auto operation. Manual operation can be performed freely by simply operating the arm by hand.The turntable shaft of the drive section is finished with centerless polishing, and high-performance special grease is used to reduce friction to 0.In addition, Teflon material is used for the bearing, and it is combined with a 30 cm aluminum die-cast 1.7 kg turntable, double-sided polishing polyurethane belt, and 4-pole synchronous motor to minimize wow and flutter.A static balance S-shaped pipe arm is used for the tone arm. It supports not only 2-channel but also 4-channel records. In addition, a vibration-resistant rubber damper is used for the weight shaft to prevent resonance.In addition, for canceling the inside force, the repulsion of the pin-like precision spring is applied, and the optimum canceling amount can be selected from 0 just by adjusting the memory of the knob according to the needle pressure.Equipped with an arm lifter.The cartridge is equipped with SV-27, a MM type cartridge.By making the mass of the vibration system extremely small, and by making the structure of the damper part holding mechanism of the cantilever unique even though it is MM type, the follow-up and transient characteristics against horizontal and vertical displacement are improved, and the phase difference between right and left channels is minimized in order to improve the phase difference which is a problem in the case of 4-channel record.A special synthetic rubber insulator is used to prevent howling.Uses a low-capacity output cord that can be connected to the rear socket to suppress high-frequency attenuation.Gold plating is used for the arm and shell connection terminals.Equipped with a lateral balancer, detachable free-stop dust cover, shell stand, and sub-weight.Equipped with muting circuit, you can enjoy smooth performance without noise or shock.Equipped with a remote control socket, by using a separately sold remote controller, automatic operation is possible from 3m away place."

name: FR-D4K
description: "A DD player with a built-in computer full auto mechanism.Computer LSI is used for the electronic circuit of the full auto mechanism.In this system, an arm position sensor and a lifter position sensor composed of LED and phototransistor are provided in the mechanism section, and the arm and arm lifter are controlled by computer LSI by inputting these sensors. During full-auto operation, the position of the arm and arm lifter, record size setting, repeat, etc. are repeatedly checked through these sensors, and the next signal is output to enable quick and accurate operation.The end groove counts the time between one pulse of the arm position sensor with a pulse counter, and reads even a slight difference of 33 and 45 rpm. When the set time and pulse width are confirmed, the arm is judged to be running in the end groove of the record and the end operation is started. When the repeat instruction is given, the arm is carried to the set point of the record which can be detected by the arm position sensor, and the arm does not return to the arm rest but lead-in.This mechanism is designed to give priority to stopping. It immediately enters the stop operation at any position of the full auto, so there is no worry of damaging the needle of the cartridge.The full-auto mechanism is equipped with a special motor to enable accurate operation.In addition, the arm and the mechanism are separated by a disk clutch, so it is designed to be contact-free so that it is not affected by the mechanism during tracing.The Dynaoptimum Balanced arm is used for the tone arm. In this method, in addition to the conventional mass concentration method, the optimum support point theory is adopted. The pivot position of the arm is set to the optimum position for dynamic balance. This prevents vibration of the pivot part from being transmitted to the cartridge and at the same time prevents unnecessary vibration from the needle tip from being transmitted to the pivot part, making excellent tracing possible.The turntable drive motor is equipped with a 20-pole 30-slot VG servo motor.Switches are installed on the front and all operations are possible with the dust cover closed.Uses cartridges made by Empire.It has a strobe on the front for better visibility with bright lighting.The cabinet uses a silver metallic cabinet that is resistant to howling, and the legs use newly developed insulators.Uses a turntable sheet with good record adhesion.Uses a new type of acrylic dust cover.Equipped with a pivot protection mechanism, even if the arm is locked to the arm rest and started by mistake, the safety device will work after 20 seconds and stop the automatic operation.In addition, the special spring protects the pivot of the arm from damage even when the arm is locked to the arm rest."

name: XR-Q5
description: "A full auto player that inherits the basic performance of the XR-Q7II as much as possible and is equipped with an MC cartridge.In order to reduce the torsional vibration of the cabinet caused by the direct drive system, we have adopted an original silent sink rotor.In the silent sync rotor system, a sync rotor is mounted on the lower part of the system, which does not move when the motor is rotating constantly, but moves only to remove the reaction when there is torque fluctuation. This absorbs the reaction between the motors and reduces the rotational vibration level of the cabinet to less than 1/4, eliminating torsional vibration.The drive motor is an FF (Friction Free) coreless motor that solves the problems of conventional coreless motors.The stator of this motor is made of non-magnetic material, and the yoke rotor, which forms the magnetic circuit, is fixed to the spindle. Therefore, by rotating exactly in the same way as the rotor magnet, there is no suction force between the stator and the magnet, and no pressure other than the weight of the rotor is applied to the bearing.Since the yoke rotor, which forms the magnetic circuit, rotates together with the magnet, ideal operation without magnetic hysteresis or eddy current is possible. In addition, smooth rotation is possible by adopting a linear drive system with sine wave that minimizes torque irregularities.When the turntable is removed and the spindle is rotated by hand, this FF coreless motor rotates more smoothly and smoothly than conventional coreless motors.Quartz lock servo system is used for the servo circuit.D. O. B. (Dynaoptimum Balanced) tone arm (optimum support point tone arm) is adopted for the tone arm.This arm was developed by approaching the mechanism of vibration transmission from the angle of theoretical analysis of the position of the fulcrum. By placing the pivot axis on the dynamic fulcrum, vibration picked up from the needle tip is prevented from being transmitted to the pivot, and external vibration is prevented from being transmitted to the needle tip.Also, a brass straight type arm pipe is adopted.The connector uses an ADC-type universal system.The cartridge is a dual-coil MC cartridge with an independent power generation mechanism for left and right channels.Although this cartridge is MC type, the needle can be changed.Equipped with a computer-controlled photoelectric detection type and contactless full auto mechanism.This system has no adverse effect on the basic performance of the arm such as deterioration of initial motion sensitivity. name: XR-Q7
description: "A record player with a silent sync rotor.In addition to adopting a direct drive system for the drive system, a new technology, Silent Synchrotor, has been incorporated to eliminate torsional vibration of the cabinet.In the direct drive system, because the motor, the driving source, is located almost in the center of the cabinet housing, a rotational force is generated in the cabinet, which is the reaction of the motor drive. This is the same phenomenon that occurs when the helicopter starts rotating in the opposite direction to the rotor rotation when the helicopter leaves. If the motor does not rotate unevenly, there is no problem. However, there is actually rotation unevenness due to load fluctuation during Mura-ya record tracing. To eliminate this rotation unevenness, the motor torque fluctuation is generated by the servo, and as the reaction, torsional vibration is generated in the cabinet in the rotational direction. Therefore, the stronger the servo effect, the larger the reaction, and the torsional vibration of the cabinet increases.The silent sink rotor generates torque in the opposite direction equal to the torque fluctuation of the turntable in the sink rotor, and combines the reaction of the turntable and the reaction of the sink rotor to eliminate the vibration of the cabinet. This reduces the rotational vibration level of the cabinet to less than 1/4 of that when the silent sink rotor is turned off.The drive motor is equipped with a newly developed FF coreless motor that solves the problems of conventional coreless motors.In conventional coreless motors, since the stator is made of magnetic material, a strong suction force acts between the stator and the magnet attached to the rotor, and strong mechanical friction is generated in the bearing. In addition, when the magnetic pole runs on the stator made of magnetic material, the rotor is dragged by a hysteresis phenomenon. Since the stator is made of conductive material, there are other problems, such as the braking effect caused by eddy current loss.In the newly developed FF coreless motor, the stator is made of non-magnetic material, and the yoke rotor, which forms the magnetic circuit, is fixed to the spindle and rotates in the same manner as the rotor magnet. Therefore, there is no suction force between the stator and the magnet, and no pressure is applied to the bearing. In addition, the yoke rotor, which forms the magnetic circuit, rotates together with the magnet, enabling ideal operation without magnetic hysteresis or eddy current.In addition, we aim for smooth and ideal rotation by adopting a linear drive system.A quartz lock system is adopted, and excellent characteristics are obtained by coating the turntable with a precise magnetic pulse of 960 poles while reviewing the bare characteristics of the motor.An optimum support point arm (Dynaoptimum Balanced Tonearm) is adopted for the tone arm part.The optimum support point arm has a structure in which the pivot shaft is placed on the dynamic support point, and vibration picked up from the needle tip is not transmitted to the pivot, and vibration from the outside is not transmitted to the needle tip, thus improving the tracing capability.In addition, the tone arm of the XR-Q7 is made of carefully selected materials. The arm base is made of zinc die-cast, the arm pipe is made of brass, and the head shell is made of aluminum die-cast. This is a highly rigid design.The pipe of the tone arm part can be replaced at the root of the arm base, and the straight arm with fixed head shell as standard equipment and the S-shaped tone arm with universal connector can be replaced.The height adjustment is ¥3 mm so that it can be adjusted according to the cartridge.Equipped with photoelectric detection type non-contact full auto mechanism controlled by 4-bit microcomputer, each auto operation of auto lead in, Oatley turn, auto cut and auto repeat is possible.Manual operation can also be performed without switching. The turntable rotates when the arm is moved from the arm rest by hand, and the tone arm can be moved up and down with the Up/Down keys.As a protective function, if the tone arm is intentionally stopped during auto operation or if the power supply is turned off with the tone arm on the record board, all operations will be stopped after 20 seconds. If the power supply is turned off with the tone arm on the record board, the tone arm returns to the time of trouble at the next power supply ON and stops in the return after lowering.High-density materials with high rigidity and little deformation are used for the cabinet to reduce the influence of howling and external vibration.The composite resin is used for the material of the turntable sheet.This is fixed to the aluminum die-cast turntable, and there is no deterioration of sound quality due to slight displacement from the turntable sheet."

name: AU-607
description: "This pre-main amplifier was developed in pursuit of physical characteristics under the development theme of creating new sound with a novel circuit that understands the essence of audio.When a program source with a large dynamic range and a dense music signal is reproduced by an amplifier with a large bare gain and a large amount of NF applied to improve the distortion, transient intermodulation distortion (Transient Intermodulation) occurs due to an unstable element such as delay in the amplifier circuit, and the resolution deteriorates. Transient Intermodulation Distortion (TIM) occurs at the summing point, which is the synthesis point of the input signal and NF signal, because the NF operation is momentarily lost due to the delay in the circuit, and an excessive input enters the amplifier. Therefore, it was difficult to achieve a wide range with conventional amplifiers.In the AU 607, we examined the bare characteristics before applying NF, and expanded the frequency characteristics, improved the phase characteristics, and reduced the distortion factor. We also improved the phase characteristics up to several tens of MHz by combining a unique phase correction circuit with an appropriate stagger ratio for phase advance and phase delay. By applying the minimum necessary NF, the transient intermodulation distortion is improved. As well as excellent response in the ultra-low frequency range, response in the ultra-high frequency range is improved, and wide-range playback is enabled.The power amplifier section uses a DC amplifier configuration.A newly developed dual FET with the same characteristics is used in the first stage. This device has a feature that allows a large current to flow approximately four times that of conventional FETs. Taking advantage of this feature, it improves the slew rate and prevents the generation of transient intermodulation distortion at the summing point where the input signal and NF signal are synthesized.The second stage employs a differential two stage amplification configuration using a low-noise transistor.In this circuit, gain is suppressed as much as possible to improve bare characteristics. In addition, a unique current mirror circuit and cascode connection are used. In addition, current differential operation is performed from the single-end output of the second stage. The pre-drive stage is configured. Because this circuit is a push-pull circuit, the second harmonic wave is canceled out, and the circuit configuration is excellent in bare characteristics and distortion rate characteristics. Moreover, it is not affected by temperature characteristics and power supply fluctuation. The transistor of this pre-drive stage is carefully selected with a particularly small hoe (emitter grounding, output conductance). In addition, a series resistor is added to the emitter side to eliminate linearity deterioration due to hoe.The output stage is a 3-stage Darlington configuration. This reduces output impedance and reduces distortion. In addition, the output transistor has good high-frequency and pulse characteristics, and stable operation with margin is obtained.As for the drift of mid-point potential, which is a problem in DC amplifiers, the DC amplifier configuration is made after realizing stability of drift by suppressing power supply fluctuation thoroughly so that the first stage of the amplifier is not affected by the output, and improving the symmetry (pair characteristic) of the summing point.The equalizer amplifier section consists of 8 transistors consisting of 1 stage differential with first stage current source, 1 stage class A amplifier with buffer and activator, and final stage pure complimentary service SEPP output-circuit. The signal system consists of 6 transistors. As with the DC power amplifier section, the circuit design is simple and substantial. Bare characteristics are emphasized, and low distortion is realized in a wide range outside the audible band (10 hz to 100 khz).In particular, a low-noise transistor is carefully selected for the differential input, and a current source circuit is added to improve the CMRR (in-phase component rejection ratio) at the summing point where the input signal and the NF signal are combined to improve the dynamic characteristics.In addition, a pure complimentary service SEPP circuit is used in the EQ output stage to obtain a high signal-to-noise ratio and sufficient dynamic merging together with sufficient gain.RIAA deviation is kept within ¥0.2 dB by using a high-precision metal film resistor and a capacitor with low capacitance error, and dynamic margin is obtained by using ¥2 power supply of high voltage with good regulation.The tone control section consists of four transistors, first stage differential amplification with current source + first stage amplification. The tone control section uses a click-type variable element to adjust sound quality with a good feeling.In addition, a tone defeat switch is installed for cases where tone adjustment is not required. The tone circuit is eliminated and flat frequency characteristics can be obtained by flat amplifier.Equipped with a subsonic filter, it can cut unwanted noise in the ultra low frequency range.Two power transformers are used in the power supply section to ensure that the left and right channels are completely independent, thereby preventing crosstalk to other channels and improving regulation.The power supply capacitor is designed to have a large capacity of 12,000 Ï‰ Fx4 to provide a stable ¥2 power supply to each circuit. In addition, the use of metallized film capacitors and constant voltage power supply circuits reduces the internal impedance of the power supply, which affects the reproducibility of sound quality. As a result, we have achieved good articulation in the low frequency range and good sound thickness and resolution in the middle and high frequency range.The protection circuit incorporates an ASO (Safe Operating Area) detection current limiter circuit and a DC detection circuit for the output terminal for high reliability.The volume is a 32-step click type that uses a 2-row detent type with less left / right channel tracking error and indication error.The preamplifier section and DC main amplifier section can be separated.The main amplifier section can be used independently, and DC input or AC input can be selected as input.It is equipped with tape play circuit, and 2 tape decks can be used.Tape play function such as air check while listening to the record and tape copy can be performed independently.Equipped with a loudness function.In addition, it is equipped with center click type balance control, headphone port, large earth port, spare AC outlet and so on.There was a rack mount adapter as an option sold separately."

name: AU-D607F
description: "This pre-main amplifier is equipped with a newly developed super feed-forward system that transcends the limits of NFB.In order to supplement the NFB technology used in conventional amplifiers and to further reduce distortion, this circuit is equipped with a newly developed Super Feedforward System. This circuit is based on the feedforward theory devised by H. S. Black in 1928. In 1975, SANSUI explored the possibility of practical use, but it crashed into a wall and was interrupted. In 1978, the research was restarted but failed. In 1980, we obtained a hint that NFB technology could be used in combination, and finally completed this circuit.This feed-forward circuit takes out only the distortion component from the original signal, combines it with the output in opposite phase, and cancels the distortion. However, this circuit is only theoretically possible and has many problems to overcome, so it was considered a phantom theory. Therefore, the Super Feed-forward system combines the advantages of both NFB and feed-forward.The NFB mainly works to improve low-frequency distortion and also takes out anti-phase distortion for feed-forward. In addition, an error collection amplifier for feed-forward is installed, and computer technology is used to develop an output summing network capable of canceling distortion even in response to 2-pole compensation, making it possible to eliminate distortion over a wide band.This super feed-forward system enables designs with low NFB, improves amplifier stability and reduces TIM distortion to almost 0.It is equipped with the diamond differential circuit adopted in the AU-D series.The diamond differential circuit is a dual complimentary service differential connection consisting of two pairs of upper and lower differential circuits. It is mounted on the pre-drive stage to deliver the necessary drive current to the power stage accurately even for transient and complex peak inputs such as music signals.The 2-pole phase compensation circuit extends the operating range of the NFB and realizes excellent high-speed response to input signals.It is designed to be simple and straight, and the signal flow is very short and simple. At the same time, three dimensional wiring is carried out to create the shortest signal path.Furthermore, by adopting a heat pipe for heat dissipation, it is possible to develop the pattern from input to output along the flow of the circuit diagram in an ideal portable type for the printed circuit board configuration. Therefore, the power stage and driver stage can be set close to each other, which was difficult with the conventional heat sink. Furthermore, the two transistors constituting the push-pull output circuit can be installed close to each other, eliminating the need to draw wires near the output transistor through which a large amount of power flows.A twin relay speaker switch is used to switch between speakers A and B to prevent the output line from being routed.By utilizing the know-how acquired through the AU-D907Limited and using a large amount of wood bonnet, bronze-plated screws, and NM elements, we are thoroughly implementing designs that are less affected by magnetic strain, including the substrate and chassis structure.The tone amplifier is omitted and the configuration consists of two amplifiers, a high-gain equalizer amplifier and a power amplifier.The EQ uses a low-noise, high-gm dual FET for the first stage, and a push-pull drive pure complimentary service SEPP output with two differentials and current differentials with a current mirror.In addition, a DC servo system is employed to remove the output capacitor while maintaining the stability of the DC region, and all signal capacitors from the input to the speaker out are eliminated.A newly developed linear servo regulator is used for the power supply dedicated to the equalizer.By supplying a constant bias current in the circuit, this stabilized power supply can provide a stable response to transient loads, enabling a clean and stable power supply at all times.The MM/M input of the AU-D607F is switched by the gain and input impedance switch of the equalizer, so that even when the MC cartridge is used, the configuration is ICL and OCL.In addition, MM/MC can be switched with the switch on the front panel, and the current position is indicated by the lighting of the indicator.The power supply section is a two independent power supply system with a 32,800 Ï‰ F custom capacitor.It is equipped with a simple tone control circuit composed of CR.Because it is a simple system without an equalizer or power amplifier, it is designed so that the tone control does not work at the volume position of -6dB to 0 db (at full power). Therefore, the saturation does not exceed the amplification of the amplifier at full power unlike the conventional system.Equipped with a subsonic filter, 2-circuit tape monitor, recording selector / copy function, audio muting, balance control, input selector with encoder, etc.There were 2 kinds, black model with Rosewood style bonnet and silver model with white oak style bonnet."

description: "This model was released in commemoration of the 20th anniversary of the 07 series which is a representative series of Sansui.It uses an Advanced Hyper � -X balanced circuit developed to reduce dynamic distortion in transmission and amplification process to 0 during operation.Both the power stage and driver stage of the vertically symmetric balanced constant current power supply are closed loop, and the operating environment with absolute stability is realized through all the system from the sound inlet to the sound outlet.The NM-LAPT audio-only device is used for the power stage. name: D-770R
description: "Auto-reverse deck equipped with Computer Reverse and Dolby C.The reverse mechanism consists of a computer for Oatley berth control, an infrared photocoupler sensor, and a 4-track inline head. name: D-970
description: "A three head cassette deck with technologies such as Computer Trek and Dolby C.It is equipped with the COMPU-TREC function in order to record and play back under ideal conditions according to the slightly different characteristics of each tape.Select the tape position (normal, chrome, or metal) with the tape select button. A special computer automatically adjusts, stores, and sets the bias, reference recording level, and equalizer characteristics that are essential for optimum recording through three test signals.The settings are displayed on the LED peak level meter for visual confirmation, and the COMPU-TREC display flashes to indicate an error when the computer judges that the adjustment is impossible due to an error in setting the tape selector.The calibration time is approximately five seconds and the tape is rewound to just before the start of the calibration.Advanced SASF is used in the mechanism part to suppress modulation noise.When the tape begins to rotate, it is rubbed by the mechanism or the head, causing slight expansion and contraction, resulting in very high-frequency longitudinal vibration (modulation noise).The Advanced Active ????? Filter (SASF) has a structure in which a scrape filter, which rotates in conjunction with the capstan by means of an elastic belt, cancels the minute vibration of the tape. The scrape filter is a fly-wheel of the same diameter as the capstan and rotates in accordance with the tape running speed, so that more stable effects can be obtained. In addition, by using a tension servo with a tape tension detection arm, the tape tension is kept constant and the contact with the SASF roller is stabilized.The advanced SASF reduces modulation noise by more than 10 dB.The amplifier circuit uses a diamond differential circuit to provide a sufficient current margin even for transient input signals to improve the sound quality. In addition, the amplifier, mechanism and computer are each used as a dedicated power source for independent windings, with ¥2 power drive and DC configuration to form a full-scale amplifier circuit to improve the sound quality.As a noise reduction system, both recording and playback are equipped with Dolby C, and simultaneous monitoring is possible even with Dolby ON.In addition, a special IC developed exclusively for the Dolby B/C and a ¥2 power supply DC amplifier configuration have been devised to achieve high-quality noise reduction effects.The head section is made of high-Bs ferrite with excellent magnetic properties. The gap length is optimized. The recording head and reproducing head are placed as close as possible in a close-gap combination structure. This makes up a 3-head system with excellent phase characteristics and high resolution.Since the head spacing is narrow, the optimum head touch of a 2-head machine is obtained, and the signal delay when switching the tape monitor switch is also reduced.When the recording level was set to REC pause, the tape monitor switch had to be switched to SOURCE. When the recording level was set to REC pause, the tape monitor switch had to be switched to TAPE. In addition, when the pause was released, recording was started, and simultaneous monitoring was desired, it had to be switched to TAPE.The D-970 is equipped with a handoff monitor function. Even if the tape monitor switch is set to TAPE, it automatically switches to SOURCE at the time of recording pause, so that the sound does not stop even in the pause state.The capstan motor uses a coreless type FG servo motor and realizes smooth tape travel by direct drive method. In addition, the capstan shaft is micro-grained to reduce unnecessary slip between the capstan and pinch roller.Dual mode electronic counter is adopted, and 4-digit electronic counter can be switched to real-time counter.In real-time mode, the time can be displayed on a time base by dividing the power supply frequency. Like a stopwatch, the time can be displayed in seconds. In this system, there is no error due to variations in tape thickness, which is seen in a system that detects the number of revolutions of the reel shaft.The counter also supports other functions such as dual elasticity and repeat.It is equipped with a dual memory repeat function that allows you to store and play between 2 points you like.By resetting the counter at the first position and storing it at the position where you want to stop, you can repeat play between those 2 points.Equipped with an auto REC mute function that creates a four second silent space.Equipped with a tape lead-in function for sending lead tape portion.Equipped with timer recording / playback function.Equipped with 12 LED peak level peak level meter.Equipped with output level volume."

name: DZ-ALPHA507R
description: "A stereo cassette deck equipped with Dolby HX-PRO.Equipped with the Dolby HX-PRO, it provides an appropriate effective bias according to the amount of high-frequency components and improves the recording capability in the high-frequency range. In the low-frequency range, low distortion and good MOL (maximum output level) can be obtained.In addition, the effective bias is maintained to minimize the phase shift and maintain the sense of orientation.The head uses an amorphous head with excellent magnetic properties.The head coil uses OFC (oxygen-free copper wire) to reduce transmission distortion, and combined with Dolby HX-PRO to improve high-frequency characteristics.In order to draw out the capabilities of various types of tapes and tapes with different characteristics, it is equipped with an auto-bias function. This function records and reproduces the signal when the key is pressed, and the optimum bias for the balance of frequency characteristics and distortion is automatically set in approximately 25 seconds.It is equipped with a unique CDFC (Computerized Dual Function Control) which condensed various functions.By eliminating the special mode key and compound operation of the basic operation key without the special mode key, it has achieved the most multi-function in its class.Equipped with tape lead-in, auto-rec mute, 20-track AMPS, rec cancel, bi-directional music scan, 1-track / all-track repeat, memory stop, and LR independent microphone input.The recording amplifier uses a constant current drive circuit that eliminates output resistance because the head drive current is constant regardless of impedance changes due to changes in the recording frequency. This greatly improves the dynamic range, prevents phase degradation, and provides a stable sense of localization.Since the playback amplifier is directly connected to the head, coupling capacitors, which adversely affect sound quality, are eliminated.In order to ensure a stable power supply and eliminate mutual interference between each unit, the power supply unit is composed of four independent power supplies, each of which is a recording / playback amplifier, a bias transmitter, a mechanical drive unit and an FL display unit.There was a side wood sold separately."

name: SC-3
description: "Cassette deck with cassette upright loading system.It uses a mechanism developed exclusively for the vertical type, and it can be loaded upright like a modern general cassette deck.This eliminates the performance degradation that occurs when the conventional horizontal mechanism is used vertically.The drive motor is an electronically controlled DC-motor, and the capstan is a high-precision capstan with a roundness of 0.1 Ï‰ or less, which reduces wow and flutter to less than 0.06%.In addition, the use of large zinc-die-cast flywheels improves the flywheel effect and reduces wow flutter and ensures stable tape travel.0.4 mm thick flat belt is exclusively used for the capstan drive belt. By using flat belt, expansion and contraction changes caused by conventional thickness are prevented as much as possible, and wow flutter characteristics are pursued.In the past, a single belt was used to drive both the fly-wheel (capstan) and the take-up reel at the same time. However, in the SC-3, a dedicated flat belt for the fly-wheel and a dedicated belt for the take-up reel are used to drive each of them independently. This prevents the capstan from being affected by load fluctuations and vibrations that occur during the take-up process, making it possible to record and play more beautiful sound.It uses cassette reverse insertion prevention weather to protect tapes and mechanism from malfunction.In addition, the cassette door has a large transparent window and is equipped with an illumination lamp so that it is possible to see the tape running, the remaining amount of the tape, and the number of songs.In addition, the cassette door can be removed for easy degaussing and cleaning of the tape head, capstan, pinch roller, etc.A quick change system is adopted in the operation part, and switching from play, rewind, fast forward, pause, etc. mode is possible without going through the stop button.It adopts an original full auto-stop mechanism using a pure electronic system.The tape stops running at the end of each mode such as play, rewind and fast forward, and the operation buttons return to their original state.This mechanism generates pulses while the tape is running, and when the tape stops running, the generation of pulses also stops and the operation button is automatically returned to its original state.A ?????? with a lock mechanism is adopted.During locking, the pinch roller is separated from the capstan to prevent deformation due to crimping of the pinch roller.Rewind and fast forward operation can be performed even when locked.Equipped with timer start mechanism, by combining with timer sold separately, it is possible to record absence and play alarm clock.The Dolby System is installed as a noise reduction system.The Dolby circuit employs a dedicated IC jointly developed by Dolby Research Laboratories and Signetics, Inc. of the United States. This eliminates the need for conventional adjustment and prevents changes in Dolby characteristics caused by misalignment and aging.Ultra-hard permalloy head with 1.6 Ï‰ narrow-gap finish is used for the read / write head.Two low-noise transistors are used in the microphone circuit to achieve a high S/N ratio and a wide range of impedance, which guarantees linearity of 40 dB for the specified input level.In line recording, the input does not go through a microphone circuit, but is a circuit dedicated to line recording. Therefore, deterioration of the S/N ratio and distortion rate is suppressed.Equipped with a VU meter.The SC-3 emphasizes the circuit of the VU meter and adopts two dedicated circuits per one channel. Along with the improvement of the scale accuracy, the dan-pin of the pointer is also good and accurate indication is possible.The equalizer uses a 2-stage NF type circuit with a large S/N ratio and dynamic range. It is equipped with a normal tape (LH) and a tape selector with a new time constant of 3180 Ï‰ S + 70 Ï‰ S.By this, in addition to normal tape and chrome tape, ferrichrome tape is also supported.Equipped with output level control.It also has independent left and right recording level controls.Equipped with 3-digit index counter.Equipped with REC / Dolby indicator using LED.Equipped with DIN recording / playback outlet.Equipped with an L/R independent microphone input terminal.It has a headphone port."

name: SD-5000
description: "This tape deck has been thoroughly examined for basic performance such as sound quality, operability, and tape protection.In addition to 2-channel recording and playback, reverse playback is available.Newly developed hard permalloy head is used for the head part.The core material uses hard permalloy, which has a high magnetic saturation point and the most excellent electromagnetic conversion characteristics. It has acquired more than five times the wear resistance of conventional permalloy.In addition, for 4-track applications, a large core is used to provide sufficient input resistance, and the low-frequency range is covered up to 20 Hz. The high-frequency characteristics are also improved by accurate gap and uniform mirror-lapping due to precision processing. In addition, the head shape is a hyperbolic type to improve the head touch and suppress undulations in the low-frequency range.A 3-motor mechanism is used for the mechanism part.A 4-pole / 8-pole hysteresis synchronous motor is used for the capstan motor. The dynamic balance of the rotor is perfectly adjusted, and the wow, flutter and speed deviation are reduced by using a large flywheel with high rotational inertia efficiency.A 6-pole induction type is used for the two reel motors.The capstan shaft is driven by a belt drive system, and the speed switching between 19cm/s and 9.5cm/s is done electrically by changing the number of poles of the motor.The capstan shaft is used for the capstan shaft, and after precise centerless polishing, super finish finish is applied.In addition, the roundness of the capstan, which determines the quality of the capstan, is carefully checked one by one using the Tully Ronde roundness measuring machine made in the United Kingdom, which is used worldwide, and is kept to a precise value of less than 0.5 ?.In order to further improve the wow and flutter characteristics, an impedance roller made of a large flywheel is adopted. At the same time, modulation noise caused by harmful vibration just before the head is eliminated. In addition, the tension of the tape is kept constant by two tension arms on the left and right sides to prevent excessive force from being applied to the tape.These mechanisms are firmly fixed to the die-cast transport base to prevent the effects of vibration and shock.All push button system with feather touch by electromagnetic plunger and relay is used for mechanical control.Each control button is completely independent and you can press the control button freely without having to go through the stop button each time, so you can quickly move to the desired action.In addition, a delay circuit is built into each operation button, so that no excessive force is applied to the tape and the pinch roller does not press on the capstan until the tension becomes constant.When you press the play button during fast forward, the tape does not become loose or cut.The E-ENF type equalizer circuit is a 3-stage amplifier with high linearity and low distortion factor. Moreover, the saturation level of the whole amplifier is set high enough so that there is no distortion due to large input.The bias oscillation circuit adopts a push-pull method and is designed so that the bias waveform is accurate and the distortion is minimized.Equipped with a recording bias selector to support low-noise tapes.In HIGH mode, the recording bias is deeper than in STANDARD mode, and the recording level is increased by 3 dB.With a record selector, you can choose between stereo and monaural recording. Also, if you set it to the standby position, recording will not start even if you accidentally press the record button.In addition, it is also possible to record after recording.It comes with an echo recording plug that can be inserted into the DIN socket to record any echo added to the line input.In addition, the input levels of the microphone and line are adjusted separately, so mixing recording and sound-on-sound are possible.Uses a Oatley bath system with sensing foils.Equipped with two large VU meters.The scale of this meter is an expanded type, close to a straight line, and the interval between low level and high level is wide, and accurate monitoring is possible.It has Queue and Pause buttons.Uses Sansui's original reel clamper.Each channel has its own level adjustment.It is compatible with the separately sold wired remote controller and can be operated from 4m away."

description: "Under the theme of improving instantaneous response, this is a bookshelf speaker system that uses bicrystal vibrating plates.Bicrystal diaphragm is used for woofer and mid-range diaphragm.This material combines two materials, polypropylene and crystalline mica. The synergistic effect of the two crystals realizes excellent material properties that cannot be obtained with a single material.This bicrystal diaphragm has two to three times higher rigidity than paper or polypropylene (olefin), and two times higher internal loss (tan �) than paper. In addition, the sound speed is 10 to 20% faster than other non-metal polymer materials, and the mass is the same as polypropylene. As a result, in addition to wide and flat response and power linearity, this bicrystal diaphragm has excellent transient response characteristics and improved instantaneous response.A 27 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.In this woofer, in order to bring out the physical properties of bicrystal more effectively, a unique micro-corrugation is applied to the cone to ensure more characteristics.A large strontium ferrite magnet with a magnetic flux density of 10,500 gauss is used for the magnetic circuit, and distortion is greatly reduced by the adoption of a T-pole.Aluminum reflex system.The front and rear baffles are equipped with 20 mm thick high-density acoustic boards, the other boards are also equipped with high-density acoustic boards, and each part is reinforced name: AU-V7000
description: "This is an AV amplifier that uses the audio technology cultivated so far and pursues high sound quality without relying on visual sense.Sound quality is an important issue, and five power amplifiers are configured discretely.We have succeeded in increasing the surround effect further by distributing the front and rear to the ideal power balance.The front L/R, center 100Wx3ch, rear 50Wx2ch 5-amp system with the same power and quality. In the case of front 3 ch, the rear signal is mixed to the front L/R to obtain an effect similar to surround sound.In addition to the ProLogic, there is also a surround mode, which uses a floating digital delay to control eight channels and six lines simultaneously. This enables a 2-channel stereo source to create a wide and rich sound field.In matrix mode, the front outputs 2 channels as they are, and the rear outputs reverberation.Hall mode is characterized by the depth of rich reverberation with a concert hall setting and the sound field with a sense of spaciousness.Stadium mode recreates the scale and enveloping sound of large live concerts and sports events.The Natural mode creates a natural sound field in contrast to a rich source of reverberation.It is equipped with a total of 10 input systems of video Line 5 and audio Line 5 corresponding to the S terminal.Equipped with an A/V parallel dubbing function that enables tape dubbing of CDs while video is being dubbed.It is also equipped with an AV mix recording and playback function that can combine video and audio from different sources.Equipped with an auto mode test tone circuit for easy adjustment.This is a function that automatically cycles around each channel and adjusts it. In addition, it is equipped with the manual mode that is also used in commercial equipment. By temporarily fixing the test tone of any selected channel, the output level and tone can be adjusted accurately.Comes standard with a programmable remote controller (RS 1260) that allows easy operation from power ON/OFF to function selection, volume adjustment, surround mode setting, etc."

name: QRX-2000
description: "A 4-channel receiver with a newly developed QS Barrio matrix circuit.Equipped with QS Barrio matrix circuit developed by SANSUI.This circuit applies an acoustic-psychological phenomenon called directional masking. When strong and weak sound simultaneously reach the ear, the direction of the weak sound is masked and becomes unclear. This phenomenon is electronically incorporated into a 4-channel circuit.Compared to conventional 3-dB-type RM decoders, this method provides theoretically infinite channel separation, so the QRX2000 is set to the most desirable value for music playback. It also provides more accurate localization and better sound quality than conventional RM decoders.Equipped with a function switch that can select various 4-channel effects.If you press the QS Synthesizer switch, you can enjoy two channel records and other four channels with the new QS Synthesizer function.The QS Regular Matrix combines the traditional RM with the Barrio Matrix to provide high quality QS4 channel playback.The phase matrix uses a unique QS Barrio matrix circuit to provide good separation for SQ playback.Discrete devices support playback of 4-channel tape decks and CD-4-demodulators.All stages are directly connected to the semi-power complimentary service circuit for the power amplifier.In the QRX 2000, attention is paid to the heat dissipation effect of the power transistor, and each channel stage is unitized and mounted on the motherboard.The front-end of the FM tuner section uses a dual-gate MOS FET and a precision 3-row varicon for higher sensitivity. The IF stage uses four ceramic filters and the MPX section uses a dedicated IC for stable sound quality.The power supply section is equipped with a power transformer of one rank higher class, the power capacitor is equipped with a ripple filter at 4,700 Ï‰ F, and a stabilized power supply circuit is used to improve the SN ratio and stability.It is equipped with functions such as tone control, loudness and tape monitor."

name: QRX-3000
description: "A 4-channel receiver with built-in newly developed QS Barrio matrix circuit that supports all 4-channel systems.The QS QS Barrio matrix circuit is incorporated in the QS synthesizer / decoder section.The QS Barrio matrix circuit is composed of square matrices and phase shifters, etc., and emphasizes natural sound field generation while improving separation and sound quality.In the newly developed QS Barrio matrix circuit, the matrix coefficient of the input signal is changed instantaneously to control the source so that the directivity becomes clearer, and the separation is improved. name: QRX-3500
description: "A top-of-the-line 4-channel receiver with built-in newly developed QS Barrio matrix circuit that supports all 4-channel systems.The QS Synthesizer / Decoder section incorporates a newly developed QS Barrio matrix circuit in addition to synthesizer / decoder functions, phase shifters and phase matrix functions.The 90 � phase shifter is designed to solve the problem of the conventional matrix circuit in which the phases of the two rear speakers were reversed. On the decoder side, the phases of the left rear speakers are shifted by -90 ¥, and the phases of the right rear speakers are shifted by + 90 �. The phases between the rear speakers are On the encoder side, the reverse operation is performed.The newly developed QS Barrio matrix circuit is an application of an acoustic phenomenon called directional masking. By instantaneously changing the matrix coefficient of the input signal, the reproduced signal is controlled so that the directivity becomes clear, and the separation is improved. Theoretically, the QS Barrio matrix circuit can obtain infinite separation between each channel by selecting the control level of the matrix coefficient, but from the viewpoint of music reproduction, it is adjusted to the optimum level for audibility. This circuit is controlled by using a phase discriminator that detects the phase of the input signal.A 2-4 conversion encoder circuit is included as a synthesizer function, and special processing is applied to the reproduction of the normal 2-channel source so that the QS Barrio matrix circuit can be effectively converted into 4 channels.Also, by adding a phase matrix circuit, SANSUI's original front / back logic is realized, and the 4-channel source created by SQ method can be reproduced with sufficient separation.It has a 4-channel aux input terminal that can be used with 4-channel tape decks or CD-4.The power amplifier section uses a pure complimentary service circuit directly connected to all stages.The protective circuit is equipped with a quick-cut fuse and a relay to prevent pop noise during power ON/OFF.A 2-stage direct-coupled NF-type equalizer circuit is used for the preamplifier section.In addition, the tone control is a click step type, and the front and rear can be controlled independently.For the front end of the tuner section, a dual gate MOS type FET and a precision four series varicon are adopted.The IF stage combines two stages of two element ceramic filters and an IC, and the multiplex circuit is also designed to improve stability by carefully selecting parts.The power supply section is equipped with a large transformer, large capacitor, and NF-type constant voltage circuit.Equipped with functions such as low / high filter, loudness and balance control.Equipped with FM input sensitivity change-over switch.LOC is used for short distances with strong signals, and DIST is used for long distances.Equipped with a muting switch, noise between stations of FM broadcasting can be reduced.Volume and balance can be controlled from a remote location by using the optional remote controller."

name: A-ALPHA7
description: "This is an integrated amplifier of the Alf series that compactly condenses the technology of the AU - � series.In A - ¥7, a combination of a diamond differential circuit and a Uilson current mirror circuit is generically called an advanced diamond differential circuit.By installing a diamond differential circuit in the power amplifier, the last stage power transistor (LAPT) can be driven with a sufficient margin, and the rise characteristic of the signal is improved, so that it can be used even in the rapidly changing digital source.A Uilson current mirror circuit is used in the first stage of the power amplifier to suppress the circuit noise generated in the first stage and improve the quality of the amplifier as a whole.The diamond differential circuit has a structure in which four transistors are operated symmetrically with each other to obtain a powerful current. By using a newly developed acoustic conversion coating, defects inside the film have been reduced by 30% compared with conventional ones. In addition, by using the new chemical conversion method, carbon content in the electrolytic solution has been reduced by 32% compared with conventional ones. In addition, we have developed and adopted an electrolytic solution with less impurities.Rotary 6-input input selector is used.Equipped with a CD direct mechanism, the transmission path of CD can be minimized and input directly to the power amplifier.Equipped with 3-mode presence control function, volume balance can be adjusted according to listening condition or combination of speakers.It uses a screw-type gold-plated speaker terminal that is compatible with banana plugs.Gold plated terminals are used for all input and output terminals.It has a processor jack that can be connected to a surround processor or an equalizer.A 32-key remote controller with CD, DECK and TUNER control is included."

radiator of the power amplifier, which consists of an advanced diamond differential circuit and LAPT, are integrated into L/R channels as completely independent units, eliminating interference between the left and right channels.In order to eliminate various vibrations and resonance given to the circuit from inside and outside of the amplifier, pure copper isolation parts are adopted between the transformer and radiator, which are vibration sources, and chassis, and the transmission path of vibration is cut off.In addition to the excellent vibration absorption capability of pure copper material, it has the advantage of being able to unify the tone and tone.Copper plated rear panel and copper plated screws are used for the rear panel to receive input / output terminals and speaker terminals in order to suppress mutual interference between connected devices.Side panel made of extruded aluminum is equipped as standard.As the weight increases due to the mounting of the side panel, high damping performance is obtained against internal vibration and low-frequency vibration from the outside.Gold-plated screws are used for mounting to the body.Starget electrolytic capacitors are used as electrolytic capacitors.This capacitor uses a newly developed acoustic chemical conversion coating that reduces the defects inside the film by 30% compared with conventional capacitors, and electrolyte with less impurities.The power supply section uses a heavyweight EI core transformer.The power unit uses many audio-only parts such as Starget electrolytic capacitors.The power cable uses name: AU-111VINTAGE1999
description: "This is a pre-main amplifier that restored the original attractiveness in 1999, 34 years after the AU 111, which was developed as the last vacuum tube amplifier of Sansui by gathering all of the technologies.Although the naming is different, in order to retain the charm of the original model, the front panel has inherited the same AU 111 logo as it was at that time.We re-examine it from the point of view at the time of re-printing in order to correspond to the latest source.Based on the specifications of the output transformer at that time and the engineers involved in its design and manufacturing, we restored and adopted the SW (Super Wide) type output transformer with large capacity output (guaranteed 30Hz/50W continuous output), low loss (0.25 dB or less), ultra-wide range (20 Hz to 100 kHz), and NFB margin (25 dB).Since it uses a complicated winding structure, each piece is finished by hand by skilled engineers.The power tube, which is the key device, uses the Svetlana brand as a result of repeated testing of 6L6GC power tubes obtained from all over the world. It is operated by 6L6GC push-pull with AB, P. P. fixed bias.The circuit configuration of the power amplifier provides sufficient open-loop gain and uses a leak Mulard type that is easy to adjust AC balance.The first stage uses 6AQ8, which has high instantaneous power and can operate at high current, and the phase inversion uses 12BH7A, and the S/N of the auditory sense is obtained.The control amplifier uses a 12AX7 4-stage amplifier circuit including the cathode follower. All of the control amplifiers are 2-stage amplified NF amplifiers, and a low-impedance output preamp can be used independently.For analog record playback, the phono equalizer is a 2-stage amplified NFB configuration of 12AX7, and it is compatible with MM cartridge with perfect shift.In addition, the MC cartridge has a separately sold A-603S type input transformer in the MT9P socket.The internal wiring is completely hand-made direct wiring without using any boards as it was at that time, and the sound quality change caused by using boards is cleared.The power supply section uses a large and large-capacity type power transformer that SUNSUI specializes in excellent regulation. It draws 480 v high voltage by double-voltage current and supplies it to the 6L6GC plate.Since the screen grid has large voltage fluctuations and cannot obtain stable high power, a Blater resistor is installed to stabilize it and enable large output.Also, you can enjoy the change of sound quality by using the detachable power cable.In addition to the low / high filter of the CR feedback system, it is equipped with an accessory circuit such as a loudness control, a presence control to improve articulation in the low frequency range, and a tape monitor.To support digital sources such as SACD and DVD-Audio, it is equipped with Route 6 input via all-gold-plated input jacks.Uses a gold plated terminal corresponding to speaker impedance of 6 � ~ 8 � and 16 �.The main chassis is made of stainless steel for sound quality and long-term use.The oil condenser (No PCB), carbon resistance, and vacuum tube socket are used as parts to keep the original tone.In particular, oil condensers used for couplings have a significant effect on sound quality, so oil condensers are installed in all couplings as they were in those days.* The following are supplementary items included in the catalog.In order to make the most of its capabilities, SANSUI recommended a combination of speakers such as WestCoast speakers (ALTEC and JBL), coaxial speakers (TANNOY), and BBC monitor speakers (spendor).Repeated ON/OFF of the power switch is prohibited. name: AU-D7
description: "A pre-main amplifier using a diamond differential circuit and newly developed linear A circuit.Equipped with the diamond differential circuit adopted in the AU-D series.This circuit is an ideal circuit that can instantaneously supply a large amount of drive current to the power stage for any input. name: AU-D55F
description: "Pre-main amplifier with super FF (feed-forward) system.The Super FF system is an original system adopted in the AU-F Extra series, and is a technology that was born by combining the feedforward theory invented by Dr. H. S. Black with NFB.The NFB is primarily responsible for reducing distortion in the audible band and also for extracting anti-phase distortion for feed-forward. As a result, the NFB is dominant in the audible band and the feed-forward is dominant outside the audible band to cancel distortion. This theoretically reduces any distortion that occurs in the power stage.This system consists of an error collection amplifier for amplifying the distortion cancellation signal and a symmetrical two pole output summing network utilizing the latest computer technology.The Super FF system is adopted in the power amplifier section, and all stages are composed of differential amplification DC amplifiers.Low-noise FET is used for the first stage and cascode bootstrap connection is used for the third stage.In the power supply section, we have developed and adopted a dual-bridge method that enhances the power supply by increasing the energy utilization factor. Compared with the conventional method, which uses two positive and two negative diodes for rectification, the dual-bridge method uses four diodes for each, improving the rectification effect by 30%.In addition, since there is no ground at the midpoint of the power transformer and the ground point is isolated from the chassis via a diode, no stray current flows into the chassis more than necessary and does not adversely affect the signal ground point.In addition, a one point grounding system has been adopted for all grounding systems, and the LED circuit and protector circuit are independent power sources to improve sound quality.The equalizer amplifier section uses a high-precision equalizer with an emphasis on disc quality.As a result, the frequency characteristics have been expanded to 100 kHz and high SN and low distortion have been achieved.In addition, an MC/MM compatible equalizer is used that supports MC and MM by changing the gain.In addition, the built-in subsonic filter suppresses waviness and distortion in the ultra-low range caused by the warping of the record.In addition to minimizing the signal path, the equalizer and power section are completely separated, and the pre-drive stage and power stage are separated by a large heat sink to promote the flux-free concept.A tone control circuit is incorporated into the NF circuit of the power section.It uses a direct access input selector that can select all inputs with one touch.The main volume is made of machined pure aluminum.Equipped with loudness and high filter."

It uses high-order oversampling and third order noise-shaping to instantaneously convert digital signals into high-precision analog signals, and has the feature that 0 cross distortion and nonlinear distortion do not occur in principle.The AU-alpha 999 dg is a unique linear & direct D/A conversion system (L. D. C. S) with the accuracy close to that of a crystal oscillator and the adoption of a lithium tantalate device with a wide lock range in order to combine the high accuracy of the Mash system with the flexibility suitable for an integrated amplifier.New L. l. D. C. S, the SN ratio has been further improved by total upgrading from peripheral circuits.In order to completely separate the digital and analog sections of the power supply section, a dedicated transformer is installed for each digital and analog circuit.In addition, the analog system uses a 64 � high-performance low-power electrolytic capacitor as well as a high-capacity transformer to ensure the expansion of the middle and low band that forms the basic part of music.The amplifier section uses a balanced circuit that does not use earth as a reference, and an � -X balanced circuit that is based on our unique know-how. The circuit itself cancels noise and distortion by the balance operation.In addition, a 4-amp configuration with dedicated amplifiers on the - and + sides provides a push-pull system that drives under the same conditions from both + and - sides, enabling playback at a low distortion rate.A twin monaural construction with the power supply in the center and the power units symmetrically arranged ensures that the digital section to be shielded outside the left channel unit and the analog input section to be shielded outside the right channel unit so that the digital and analog sections are clearly separated.Equipped with a remote controller, volume Up down and total 11 input source switching can be performed in listening position.It is equipped with functions such as source direct operation, REC selector and direct access rotary switch.Uses gold-plated input terminal, very thick power cord with polarity display, and AC outlet."

name: AU-X1
description: "An amplifier designed to pursue the ideal that ""an amplifier must be a single conductor with an amplification degree that faithfully transmits music signals"" as far as possible.Approximately half of the space is the power supply. All stages are independent on the left and right, power stage, pre-drive stage, flat amplifier / equalizer and MC head amplifier are all independent 8 power supply configurations.It is a 2-transformer system consisting of a 600 VA large-capacity toroidal transformer and an 80 VI Ï‰ EI transformer. Custom large-capacity electrolytic capacitor 10,000 Ï‰ Fx8 developed exclusively for audio is connected in parallel. A 1.2 mm thick copper plate is used in the ground circuit. Therefore, even if the speaker impedance changes with frequency, stable operation is achieved by the powerful power supply.Equipped with a diamond differential circuit and newly developed linear high-speed output device NM-LAPT (Non Magnetic-Linear Amp. Power Transistor), we succeeded in reducing TIM distortion and envelope distortion, which are dynamic distortions that interfere with sound quality, to as close to 0 as possible.From large die-cast heat sinker to high-efficiency triple-braided speaker cable wiring, each part is selected based on a reliable characteristic check and hearing.The power amplifier operation switch on the front panel can be used to separate pre-power and power.Power is supplied to the power stage using two windings with independent left and right channels and a large toroidal transformer (power supply capacity 600 va) with good regulation by two rectifier circuits. In addition, a custom large-capacity electrolytic capacitor 10,000 Ï‰ Fx8 developed exclusively for audio is connected in parallel, and a 1.2 mm thick copper plate is used for the ground circuit.The pre-drive stage uses a large EI transformer (80 VA power supply capacity) with two independent power supplies for both left and right channels to powerfully drive the diamond differential circuit.The equalizer amplifier and flat amplifier are supplied from independent constant-voltage circuits on the left and right sides, and the MC head amplifier is supplied from independent low-voltage circuits on the left and right sides with separate windings.The newly developed NM-LAPT with high breakdown strength and cut-off frequency (ft100MHz) as a power transistor with high speed and excellent linearity is made into a triple push-pull connection, and is used at an operating point with excellent linearity.The head amplifier section is a DC amplifier configuration that further advances symmetrical push-pull input / output using newly developed low-noise, high-gmP-ch and N-ch FET. The first stage is a direct-coupled push-pull input in which a large number of low-noise, high-gmP-ch and N-ch FETs are connected in parallel, realizing ideal input impedance and high S/N ratio.The second stage is an MC amplifier circuit with excellent linearity and excellent open-loop characteristics due to a push-pull drive double-stage direct connection circuit using a combination of NPN-PNP transistors.In addition, extremely stable operation is obtained by supplying power exclusively for MC and independently for the left and right.The equalizer amplifier section consists of a direct-coupled DC amplifier with a diamond differential circuit. The first stage has good pair characteristics, low-noise, high-gm, differential input circuit using dual FET, and cascode bootstrap circuit which is not affected by input impedance.In addition, the high-performance constant current circuit (PAT. PEND) composed of a 2-stage direct-coupled circuit composed of NPN-PNP transistor combination provides high CMRR (in-phase component suppression cost) at the summing point and excellent dynamic characteristics. The second and third stages are diamond differential circuit + current differential push-pull with excellent drive capability, and the output stage is SEPP circuit with Darlington connection, which has sufficient current margin. The low-output impedance and low-impedance NF circuit design provides sufficient dynamic range even against changes in load impedance, and S/N ratio is improved.The flat amplifier adopts a push-pull drive DC amplifier configuration with a differential input circuit using newly developed 1 Tip (4 elements enclosed) FET in the first stage, and achieves excellent operation by independent power supply on the left and right.The speaker wiring cord from the LAPT uses a high-efficiency 3-layer braided structure with ultra-low DC resistance and low inductance to obtain excellent transmission characteristics without deteriorating the slew rate.Uses CP type (conductive plastic) master volume."

name: AU-X11
description: "This master integrated DC amplifier was developed in pursuit of the ideal form of i-Integrated Amplifier and by putting all sound technologies into it.Super FF & diamond differential circuit is adopted for the power stage.The Super FF system is a combination of NFB and feed-forward, and theoretically cancels any distortion generated in the power stage. The structure of this system is that the distortion is reduced by NFB, and the distortion component is extracted after the pre-drive stage by its distortion component detection function. The distortion cancellation signal is amplified by the error collection amplifier forming the feed-forward circuit in the same way as the red signal circuit, and the two signals are synthesized at the output. In addition, the summing point is matched by the adoption of accurate and stable summing network.The diamond differential circuit has a structure in which transistors are arranged in the shape of a diamond, and the current margin of the drive stage can be made infinitely large to realize the high-speed response of the drive stage.The equalizer amplifier uses a low-noise, high-gm dual FET and a diamond differential circuit to enhance sound quality.In addition, a DC servo configuration is adopted.The MC head amplifier section adopts a DC amplifier configuration of single-channel 14-stone FET and push-pull input / output power supply system exclusively for left and right sides.In the power supply section, a large toroidal transformer for the power amplifier stage and a large EI transformer for the voltage amplifier stage are adopted. There are eight power supplies, power stage, pre-drive stage, flat amplifier / equalizer, and MC head amplifier completely independent on the left and right sides.All copper plated chassis, NM elements, wood bonnet and copper plated screws are flux-free."

name: AU-X111MOSVINTAGE
description: "Based on the circuit technology and know-how up to that time, this pre-main amplifier was developed through uncompromising selection of parts, improvement and hearing test.While applying the know-how accumulated in the development of the C-2301 and B-2301L Separate Amplifiers, we have implemented thorough anti-vibration design, deadening, and electromagnetic wave splash prevention measures. In addition, we have developed custom-made parts and used proven parts.A MOS FET is used as the power element. Four parallel push-pull elements are used at four locations on the left and right sides of the power stage and plus / minus sides, for a total of 16 elements. This enhances the low-impedance drive capability and provides a highly stable drive.In addition, hum and noise components are canceled by balance transmission and amplification, and the ground is separated from the - side so that it is not affected by the ground. Therefore, it is resistant to noise interference and hum from the outside, and the SN ratio and transparency of the auditory sense are improved.In order to prevent AC lines contaminated with clock pulses and phase control noise from home appliances and microcomputers, the power supply circuit is a balanced power supply configuration with a closed loop regardless of the ground color, similar to the amplifier circuit.In order to be compatible with video equipment, an input terminal for video is mounted.In order to prevent the high-frequency components of video signals from adversely affecting sound quality, the video signals are not wired in the chassis at all. Instead, they are processed by IC switches on the back of the rear panel pin jack. The power for the IC is supplied from a transformer other than the audio system. This completely eliminates both physical and electrical power.In addition, the IC switch itself has a passband of 10 MHz to prevent image quality degradation.It is compact and high-performance with that can be said to be equipped with two monaural amplifiers, and is compact and high-performance.It is equipped with the Power Direct function. When this function is ON, all operations of the pre-section and control section are shut off and the signal from the dedicated input terminal is amplified.In addition, in order to adjust the volume even in this case, it is equipped with an independent volume for the left and right.In order to improve the operation feeling, we have adopted a slightly pleasant switch click, a knob made of unpolished aluminum, a side panel made of extruded aluminum, a shower light that illuminates switches, etc.The speaker switches are installed Route 3, with large speaker jacks and canon-type jacks.The front panel can be used to separate the PRE and MAIN sections, the left and right independent power amplifier input levels are provided, and the Route 3 power amplifier / direct input is provided.It is equipped with functions such as REC selector with Off position, balance control and headphone port."

name: AU-X1111MOSVINTAGE
description: "This is the last amplifier in the X series that started with AU-X1.Earth-based amplifiers drive the speakers between the output of the amplifier and the ground, so they are susceptible to noise and distortion from the ground, which degrade sound quality.In order to solve this problem, we have adopted a balanced circuit that is not grounded. In this circuit, the - side of the speaker is double-push-pull driven in both directions under the same conditions as the + side. This eliminates unnecessary high-frequency components such as noise and distortion, and realizes an excellent sound image at a low distortion rate.In addition, there is no noise from the power supply and no IHM (Interface Hum Modulation) caused by back electromotive force from the speakers.It also supports changes in the impedance and phase of speakers.The power supply circuit that operates the balanced circuit is also a closed loop with no connection to the ground circuit.In addition, we have achieved low impedance and high speed in the entire power supply by adopting a newly developed heavy-duty transformer that has been carefully examined from the viewpoints of sound quality and electrical performance without simply pursuing a sense of weight. We have also examined various aspects from capacity to core material and winding material. We have also selected custom-made electrolytic capacitors for audio and fast recovery diodes.In order to prevent noise from connected digital devices, we do not insert a line filter. Instead, we use a unique balance transmission method from the signal circuit including the power stage to the power supply circuit.In the signal path, the + side and the - side are transmitted in a balanced manner so that hum and noise components can be canceled. Moreover, the ground is separated from the - side so that it is not affected by hum and noise components.As a result, the S / N ratio and transparency of the sound are improved.The twin monaural construction is based on the concept of a separate power amplifier. The power supply section centered on a large power transformer is placed in the center, and the power amplifier section mounted on the heat sinker is separated symmetrically. This effectively improves crosstalk between L/R units and interference between power supply system vibration and music signal.In addition, the master volume and the left and right volumes are completely independent.In addition to improving the shielding characteristics between stages and eliminating mutual interference of signals, the effects of external digital electromagnetic noise and magnetic distortion are also eliminated.The power MOS FET, power transformer and master volume are mounted on a pure copper plate. The bottom plate is shielded by copper plating. A large insulator made of pure copper muku covered with felt is also used to reduce the influence of the ground surface on sound quality. Thus, detailed measures against vibration are taken.A total of 16 MOS FETs are used in the diamond power stage, and four double-push-pull FETs are used in four places on the left, right and + - sides of the power stage.It is equipped with an image input terminal is compatible with switching and dubbing of images when a VTR is connected.To cope with the problem that high-frequency components of video signals adversely affect sound quality, the video signals are processed by IC switches on the back of the pin jacks on the rear panel without any wiring inside the chassis.In addition, the power for the IC is supplied from a transformer separate from the audio system, and a single ON/OFF switch is provided. Thus, the cross point between the audio and video signals is completely separated physically and electrically.In order to pursue the real quality of design, wood panels made of real rosewood are used on both sides and the top. In addition, front glass panel and shower light are used.Equipped with a presence control function that slightly raises the middle and low band energy without changing the tone even when playing back at a low volume.Front panel can be used to separate the front and main parts. Equipped with left and right independent power amplifier input levels."

This supports high power with plenty of room and completely eliminates IHM, which is extremely harmful to sound quality.The chassis structure uses a sub-chassis made of pure copper to provide electromagnetic and electromagnetic shielding and vibration isolation through moderate internal loss. In addition, the chassis uses a case made of pure copper and a robust aluminum chassis to provide shielding and vibration suppression from the material.In addition, the power transistor is sandwiched between a special aluminum block and a pure copper plate to prevent vibration, which is firmly fixed to a large heat sink to prevent electromagnetic radiation while significantly reducing vibration levels.In addition to the newly developed pure focus capacitor used for the power supply, the signal system uses a copper foil styrene capacitor that has been carefully examined in terms of sound quality and a butyl capacitor with damping material that prevents vibration. The power transistor uses the best product that eliminates resonance phenomena. In addition, we use extremely high-quality carbon resistance and lambda resistance. We carefully select the best parts that can be expected at that time.The printed pattern drawn on the printed circuit board has a thickness of 140 Ï‰ m, which is four times the normal thickness, and the impedance is extremely low in direct current and alternating current.A LCD power meter is used for the display.This is a logarithmic compression type meter that can read up to -60dB and can reliably monitor output even from a remote location.
